title: Aromatic Tender Chinese Fish Shui Zhu Yu
description: This peppery and tender Chinese dish is made with cooking wine and a mother sauce base, wrapped in pandan leaves for a nostalgic flavor, and is ayurvedic rajasic friendly.
instructions: Prepare the pandan leaves by cleaning and cutting them into suitable sizes for wrapping the fish.
Mix the cooking wine, mother sauce, sliced ginger, minced garlic, and peppercorns in a bowl.
Place a fish fillet in the center of each pandan leaf and brush the mixed sauce on both sides of the fish.
Wrap the fish with the pandan leaves and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add the wrapped fish.
Cook the fish for 5 minutes on each side or until it is cooked through.
Remove the fish from the skillet and garnish with chopped scallions.
Serve the fish hot with steamed vegetables or rice.
